title: Grothak, the Gorged King
text: Grothak's debtbound court drags his tithe-throne between the Inner Reach vaults. If you lose, suffer 2 Wounds. If you win, tear 2 Salvage from the throne's tribute chains.
flavor: Every road beneath his shadow ends at an open hand.
